root_idea.summary: The root centers on a forceful blow to the head that reaches the brain, with extensions to things that penetrate or decisively overcome their targets.
root_idea.development: The concrete head-breaking image develops into names for wounds, instruments, and objects that reach or affect the brain, and figuratively into the decisive defeat and abolition of an opponent or falsehood.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested Form I verb is presented under the normalized perfect-tense dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: To overcome, subdue, and abolish an opponent decisively.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction of 21:18, truth is cast upon falsehood and defeats it so completely that it is nullified or rendered despicable. The usage is figurative, drawing on the image of crushing the head or brain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break or strike the head so that the wound or blow reaches the brain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same branch includes striking the brain and, in a reported construction with the sun as subject, causing pain in the brain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the produce of land: to be eaten or consumed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported in the construction دُمِغَتِ الأَرْضُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To slaughter a sheep or goat for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited report specifies a lean animal, while another report allows a fat animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or put a دَامِغَةٌ on a حَوِيَّةٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction concerns a stuffed riding pad or related item placed on a camel; the source does not make the subject’s gender a lexical restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a ثَرِيدَةٌ soft with grease or gravy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Form II culinary usage concerning a dish of crumbled or broken bread.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The brain, understood as the marrow or stuffing of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The entry gives أَدْمِغَةٌ and دُمُغٌ as plural forms.

other_classical_meanings.headword_arabic: أُمُّ الهَامِ / أُمُّ الرَّأْسِ / أُمُّ الدِّمَاغِ
other_classical_meanings.definition: A thin membrane or pouch in which the brain is contained.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passage presents this identification with an editorial qualification and suggests that the related expressions may designate the meninx.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having the head broken so that the wound reaches the brain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective describing a person who has suffered this injury; its plural is used of men and women.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Stupid, foolish, or deficient in intellect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This use is reported as vulgar or nonstandard and is specifically said not to be established in chaste speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A conclusive or decisively compelling proof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative usage based on the force of a blow that overcomes and destroys its opponent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A head wound that reaches the brain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is described as the final degree among the wounds called شِجَاجٌ and as normally fatal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hard spadix emerging from the broken portions of a palm tree’s heart and damaging the tree if not removed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is detached when its presence is recognized because it mars the palm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An iron brace fitted across or above the rear or upper extremities of a camel saddle’s framework.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Descriptions differ on its precise placement and whether it is made of iron or wood; it is also called غَاشِيَةٌ in one report.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A crosspiece of wood placed between two poles to support a skin used for water or milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an implement meaning distinct from the saddle brace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something that wounds so as to reach the brain, or that strikes with great force.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may describe an agent or instrument; حَجَرٌ دَامُوغَةٌ is a stone that acts with exceptional force, with the feminine ending expressing intensiveness.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Literal head- and brain-breaking branch, including the reported sun construction.
Construction involving placement of a دامغة on a حوية.
Brain definition and qualified related membrane terminology.
Reported foolishness meaning with usage qualification.
Crosspiece supporting a water or milk skin.
Agent or instrument that reaches the brain or strikes forcefully.

cautions: The Quranic occurrence is interpreted as figurative decisive defeat, although the wording is explained through the literal image of breaking the head or brain.
